title: Palindrome Check
prompt: A puzzle app checks simple lowercase word challenges. Write a function that returns true when the lowercase string reads the same forwards and backwards, otherwise false.

explanation.beginner:
Example: isPalindrome("racecar") produces true. The result must follow this precise rule: A puzzle app checks simple lowercase word challenges. Write a function that returns true when the lowercase string reads the same forwards and backwards, otherwise false. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “rejects a non-palindrome”: input ["forge"] produces false. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
